newsitem.title: CHINA: CHINA FOODS IN HK$308 MLN SHARE ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: CHINA FOODS IN HK$308 MLN SHARE ISSUE.

text.p: China Foods Holdings Ltd said it had agreed to issue 70 million new shares to its controlling shareholder Top Glory International Holdings Ltd at HK$4.50 a share, raising net proceeds of HK$308 million.

The company said in a statement on Thursday that Top Glory had also agreed to place 70 million shares, or about 11.9 percent of China Foods' existing share capital, to independent investors at HK$4.50 per share.

"The net proceeds of the subscription of about HK$308 million will be used as general working capital of China Foods and for future investments in food-related industries," China Foods said. "The group will continue to explore investment opportunities in food-related industries."
But China Foods said no negotiations had been undertaken or definite decisions made to proceed with any acquisition.
After the transactions, Top Glory's stake in China Foods would be diluted to 51.1 percent from a current 57.2 percent.
Trading in China Foods shares was suspended on Wednesday and was due to resume on Thursday. The stock last traded at HK$4.75.
